arStrings.szText: Each Druid form gains a bonus every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.

Each Druid form gains a bonus every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds:

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Wolf{/c} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Bear{/c} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} stack of  {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Human{/c} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} stack of  {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
